# `unknown_var` for the same reason `$nosuch` does. Each is paired with
# the surviving spelling that carries what the removed name meant --
# `$SELF.c` was only ever `$.c`, `$PARENT.c` only ever `.c` -- so the
# BEHAVIOUR the old rows pinned is still pinned, one line down.

# A reserved name mid-path was a `ref` refusal for being in the wrong
# POSITION; an unbound variable is refused wherever it stands.
